title: CobbleBoss Datapack
description: The Cobbleboss data pack provides template JSON files for fire, water, and grass bosses. Users can follow them or create custom bosses to enhance Minecraft gameplay creatively.
body: The Cobbleboss data pack contains a variety of template boss files designed for Minecraft. Each JSON file represents a unique boss character, categorized by elemental types such as fire, water, and grass. Users can follow these templates to create their own custom bosses or modify existing ones, providing flexibility and creativity in game design. The pack also includes the pack.mcmeta file to define metadata for the data pack, ensuring proper integration into Minecraft. With this structure, players can expand their gameplay with personalized challenges and unique boss encounters.
